rows.Reason: One batch is being withdrawn from sale because of a pesticide residue found in the product; one batch of the Smooth variant is being withdrawn as a precaution
rows.Notes: Discovered via news: ruokavirasto.fi [locality: Finland] [morning fix pass 2026-11-24: THE HAZARD ON THIS ROW WAS WRONG, and the publish gate was right to hold it. The gate refused it because Pathogen 'Contaminated with an antimicrobial agent' matches no word any subscriber alert offers. The gate's own message offers two readings — the value is wrong, or the vocabulary needs the term — and here it is the first. Read on the Ruokavirasto notice today (https://www.ruokavirasto.fi/elintarvikkeet/ohjeita-kuluttajille/takaisinvedot-2023-/kahden-maapahkinavoituotteen-takaisinveto/, published 23. marraskuuta 2026): "Midsona Finland Oy on ilmoittanut vetävänsä myynnistä yhden erän Urtekram Peanut Butter Crunchy 230 g -tuotetta siinä todetun torjunta-ainejäämän vuoksi", and in addition "yksi erä Urtekram Peanut Butter Smooth 230 g -tuotetta vedetään myynnistä varotoimenpiteenä". "Torjunta-aine" is a plant-protection product and "torjunta-ainejäämä" is a pesticide residue; it is not an antimicrobial, and the collector's "antimicrobial agent" is a mistranslation of it. The notice names no specific active substance and gives no measured level or limit, so none is claimed here. Best-before dates on the notice: Crunchy 15.4.2027, Smooth 14.4.2027; no lot codes are published. 'Pesticide residue' is already reachable by a subscriber alert, so tools/alert_vocab.py is NOT changed. [original Reason (en, collector): "The products are being recalled due to contamination with an antimicrobial agent. The products are also being withdrawn as a precautionary measure."]] [promote 2026-11-24: status 'pending'->'pending' — passes every publish-gate rule]
